shots.action: The camera cuts to a tight view of a single water bead clinging to the same night-darkened bus glass, its surface catching a small blurred point of amber light. shots.what_changes: A single bead breaks free and runs down the glass, absorbing smaller drops and clearing a track behind it.

description.text: A locked view fills the frame with a rain-slicked bus window at night. Fine droplets bead across the dark glass, some scattered and still, others swelling into fattened runs that drag thin, wavering trails downward. Beyond the pane, out-of-focus streetlights and passing headlights bloom into soft amber and cold blue smears, drifting slowly across the wet surface. The glass remains the dominant plane, its reflections trembling as water gathers and slips, while the blurred city glow pulses gently behind it. Near the lower edge, several drops merge into a shallow ridge before sliding free.
Rain beads and streaked city lights fill the night-darkened window.
Soft rain patters against the glass over the low hum of the moving bus.
Droplets thicken and merge, sending wavering trails down the pane.
Amber and blue reflections slide across the wet glass.
The camera holds a static shot.

The view tightens on a single bead of rainwater clinging to the same night-darkened bus glass. Its curved surface catches a small, blurred point of amber light, and a cluster of smaller droplets rests around its base. The bead swells, breaks loose, and slides downward in a quick irregular track, gathering the smaller drops into itself and leaving a clear, wavering seam behind. Beyond the glass, the out-of-focus city glow trembles faintly, its soft colors stretching as the runnel grows.
A single water bead clings to the dark glass, lit by a blurred amber point.
A faint tick sounds as the drop breaks loose against the glass.
The bead runs downward, absorbing smaller droplets and clearing a wavering track.
The cleared seam catches the trembling city glow beyond the pane.
The camera holds a static shot.
